description: Uses the browser's native smooth scrolling to bring target into the root viewport, sends real wheel input to a visible container by direction and amount, or sends real wheel input to the page viewport when neither locator is provided. target mode derives direction automatically; container and viewport modes use direction and amount.

pageId.description: Page ID whose content should be scrolled.

anyOf.description: Element that must be brought into the root viewport. The id is preferred and selector is its fallback.
Optional scroll container that must control target exposure. Necessary outer containers may also move.
Visible scrollable container that receives the requested wheel input.
Maximum CSS-pixel distance of each bounded native smooth-scroll command while revealing target.
Requested wheel distance in CSS pixels. Zero reads scroll state without dispatching input.
Requested viewport wheel distance in CSS pixels. Zero reads scroll state without dispatching input.
Direction of the wheel input within container.
Direction of the wheel input in the page viewport.

purpose.description: Describe whether this scroll should reveal a target, move content inside a known container, or browse farther in the page viewport. For target mode, explain the interaction that will follow after the target becomes visible.
